contract: The page must expose window.panel.state() returning an array of three booleans, one per lamp.

steps.name: loads with no page or console errors and exposes three lamps, all off
steps.expect: errors.length === 0 && Array.isArray(state) && state.length === 3 && state.every((x) => x === false)

steps.name: pressing 1 turns the first lamp on and leaves the others alone
steps.expect: state[0] === true && state[1] === before[1] && state[2] === before[2]

steps.name: pressing 2 and 3 turns the other two on
pressing 1 again toggles the first lamp back off
steps.expect: state[0] === false && state[1] === true && state[2] === true

steps.name: pressing 0 again leaves every lamp off - it never turns one on
after 0, the individual toggles still work
steps.expect: state[1] === true && state[0] === false && state[2] === false

steps.name: no page or console error was raised at any point during the run
